pose_usable_semantics: Binary conservative gate, not probability: per-frame conditional heldout mean<=3px and visiblemaskIoU>=.9. Missing heldout evidence gets0. Global motion/image guards also required.
notice: Contact-ready denotes passed weak-experiment guards plus closed topology and finite poses only. It does not certify camera, scale, hidden geometry or physical contact accuracy. Scale sensitivity0.8/1/1.2 is a chosen experiment range, not a calibrated interval.
